scenarios.label: greeting
scenarios.text: Aye, I am on duty at the north gate. Keep your voice down; the captain wants the peace maintained here in Bellweather. What business brings you this way from the road?

scenarios.label: responsive-factual
scenarios.text: The captain ordered us not to speculate on what's happening near Old Briar Wood. Just keep clear of the northern edge of the woods, Traveler.

scenarios.label: long-followup
scenarios.text: Stick to the main path; the stone near the north gate is safest right now. Keep your pace steady and don't stray toward the Old Briar Wood treeline. Stick to what the captain says about the road.

scenarios.label: guard-threat-assess
scenarios.text: You watch the north road too closely, Traveler. Keep your voice down, or you'll draw attention to this watch post.
